title: Queue Health Receipt
description: Queue health receipt, schema version 2 (#15387). GREEN is earned only by a complete, current, subject-bound live observation; every weaker evidence state is NOT_PROVEN and permits only read-only investigation and exact evidence refresh.

source.description: LIVE observations only can authorize mutating lanes; OFFLINE_FIXTURE output can never be consumed as live queue authorization.

master_sha.description: Exact default-branch subject the observation binds to; a full 40-character object id when observed, empty only when no usable input was available.
